declared_for.description: Scope the view is declared for; reading an administrative dashboard requires a grant covering this scope, and holding it grants no right to change what it shows.

source_addresses.description: Authoritative records the view was rebuilt from; every rendered value must resolve to one of them.

omissions.description: Sources deliberately left out of this rebuild; may be empty but must be declared.

rebuild_operation_id.description: Operation that produced this rebuild; a second rebuild from the same records must yield the same content_digest.

authoritative.description: A projection never becomes authoritative by convenience; a projection-originated edit returns as a proposal through the transition contract.
